description: GitHub Copilot CLI default — --allow-all-tools (required for non-interactive --prompt mode), -s so stdout carries the reply alone, and --no-auto-update so the binary cannot change under a run. No --continue: it resumes the machine's most recent session whatever the directory, and has been observed injecting a prompt into a live session (#239); pin a session with `r4t engine copilot run --session <uuid>` instead.
